verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a local LLM runtime. Its built-in web UI (`llama serve`) and CLI chat, including vision sessions, let users feed in their own data and get AI-generated output. One user hands-on report describes generating keywords, descriptions and location clues from their own trip photos. It does not offer an insights or suggestions feature over stored data: the user must manually supply content via chat or prompts. Missing for 10: built-in data ingestion or connectors, a dedicated insights/suggestions feature, and documentation of data-analysis workflows inside the UI.
